scope: Audio diagnostics remain report-only. Integrity withholding now requires an assessed check from an independent evidence tier (signed_attestation or recorder_metadata); see README 'Evidence tiers'.
accuracy_claim: Synthetic engineering checks only; candidate thresholds remain uncalibrated.

long_source_check.fixture: Synthetic 180-second tone sequence; 20-second excerpt at 97.3 seconds.

fixes: SpectroMap peak_search runs on fixed peak_window_seconds windows so peak density no longer falls with file length; peak pairs use exact bins and a 32-frame zone.
A severe-contradiction cap is explained in Integrity reasoning and recorded in assessment_checks.severe_contradiction_cap.
Worker protocol violations become structured unavailability; crashed providers report a stderr tail; a worker start failure affects only its own task.
mean_votes_per_offset_bin is averaged over every feasible offset rather than only the voted span, which inflated it for narrow histograms (found on real data).
One worker per task runs every provider, decoding each file range once; rows finished before a timeout or crash are kept.
Fingerprint agreement: offsets where audfprint and SpectroMap both voted, including sub-threshold votes, with a Poisson chance estimate; report-only.
CompSheet selections without target_end_seconds copy the declared source span and are flagged range_source=derived_from_declared_source_duration.
AUDIO_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_APPLICABLE info finding when no audio-to-audio relationship can be analysed.
Scoring profile default-v2: cross-evidence checks carry evidence_tier; only signed_attestation and recorder_metadata release Integrity without a contradiction.
Recorder BWF/iXML metadata, sound report CSV and AAF (pyaaf2) parsers with recorder_metadata cross-checks.
Score explanations: assessment_checks.score_explanations per axis; every failed check stated with its compared values (e.g. a 2.00 s timecode gap); timecode mismatches stay ordinary contradictions.
WAV files with complete audio but damaged trailing metadata are accepted with a damaged_trailing_metadata_ignored warning.
music_semantics provider: key, tempo, beat chords and 16-beat phrase form, compared across versions against a shuffled-harmony baseline; librosa cross-file matches demoted to summary statistics.
WORKFLOW_EVIDENCE_OUTSIDE_POLICY: evidence the workflow does not describe is reported as inconclusive and leaves completeness unchanged.
Ableton Live session parser with count-based source-audio, tempo and time-signature checks (submitter_document tier).
benchmarks/music_benchmark.py for Slakh/BabySlakh and MUSDB18-HQ with true and control stems (datasets not included).

real_data_check.dataset: Local production dataset (251 WAV, sound reports, AAF edits); not distributed
